SELECT * FROM ai_task WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND owner_id=#{owner} AND request_key=#{key}

SELECT * FROM ai_task WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_task SET status='RUNNING',lease_epoch=lease_epoch+1,worker_id=#{worker}, lease_expires_at=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,#{seconds},UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)),attempt_count=attempt_count+1, revision=revision+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6),retryable=FALSE,error_code=NULL WHERE task_id=#{id} AND (status='QUEUED' OR (status='RUNNING' AND lease_expires_at<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))) AND attempt_count<5
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_task WHERE task_id=#{id} AND status='RUNNING' AND worker_id=#{worker} AND lease_epoch=#{epoch} AND lease_expires_at>UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_task SET event_sequence=event_sequence+1 WHERE task_id=#{id} AND event_sequence<4096
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_task_event WHERE task_id=#{id} AND operation_key=#{key}
SELECT * FROM ai_task_event WHERE task_id=#{id} AND sequence>#{after} ORDER BY sequence LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_task SET status=#{status},result_json=#{result},result_sha256=#{sha},completion_key=#{key}, error_code=#{error},retryable=#{retryable},lease_expires_at=NULL,revision=revision+1, updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE task_id=#{id} AND status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING')

UPDATE ai_task SET status='QUEUED',resume_count=resume_count+1,attempt_count=0,revision=revision+1, worker_id=NULL,retryable=FALSE,error_code=NULL,completion_key=NULL,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE task_id=#{id} AND status='FAILED' AND retryable=TRUE AND resume_count<3
UPDATE ai_task SET checkpoint_json=#{value} WHERE task_id=#{id} AND status='RUNNING'
